question.problem:
Given that the differential equation 

$$
\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}+4y=-4\operatorname{sin}⁡2x
$$

has the complementary function ${y}_{c}(x)=A\operatorname{cos}⁡2x+B\operatorname{sin}⁡2x$, find the particular solution ${y}_{p}(x)$ to this equation.
question.worked_solution:
The particular solution of the inhomogeneous equation cannot be of the form $\alpha \operatorname{cos}⁡2x+\beta \operatorname{sin}⁡2x$ because this is already included in the complementary function. Therefore, we assume a particular solution of the form

$$
{y}_{p}=x(\alpha \operatorname{cos}⁡2x+\beta \operatorname{sin}⁡2x),
$$

where $\alpha $ and $\beta $ are constants that are to be determined. 

Calculating the first and second derivatives of ${y}_{p}$ gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}{y}_{p}}{\text{d}x} & =(\alpha \operatorname{cos}⁡2x+\beta \operatorname{sin}⁡2x)+2x(-\alpha \operatorname{sin}⁡2x+\beta \operatorname{cos}⁡2x) \\ \frac{{\text{d}}^{2}{y}_{p}}{\text{d}{x}^{2}} & =4(-\alpha \operatorname{sin}⁡2x+\beta \operatorname{cos}⁡2x)-4x(\alpha \operatorname{cos}⁡2x+\beta \operatorname{sin}⁡2x)\end{aligned}
$$

To find the values of $\alpha $ and $\beta ,$ we substitute the derivatives into the differential equation:

$$
4(-\alpha \operatorname{sin}⁡2x+\beta \operatorname{cos}⁡2x)-4x(\alpha \operatorname{cos}⁡2x+\beta \operatorname{sin}⁡2x)+4x(\alpha \operatorname{cos}⁡2x+\beta \operatorname{sin}⁡2x)=-4\operatorname{sin}⁡2x
$$

Grouping the terms on the left-hand side gives

$$
-4\alpha \operatorname{sin}⁡2x+4\beta \operatorname{cos}⁡2x=-4\operatorname{sin}⁡2x.
$$

Equating the coefficients, we get the following system of equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}\{\begin{aligned}4\beta =0\, & (\text{equating the coefficients of}\,\,\operatorname{cos}⁡2x) \\ -4\alpha =-4\, & (\text{equating the coefficients of}\,\,\operatorname{sin}⁡2x)\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Solving this system gives $\alpha =1$ and $\beta =0.$ Therefore, the particular solution ${y}_{p}(x)$ is

$$
{y}_{p}(x)=x\operatorname{cos}⁡2x.
$$
